about: THE NEIGHBOURHOOD SHOP (f1_neighbourhood_shop) review views. Venue frame: world x = 686 - X, z = 70.625 + D, y = 2.3 + Y (X across the frontage, D into the building, Y up from the floor). Make: python -I tools/blender/neighbourhood_shop/export_shop.py; lune run tools/bake/main.luau (+ editor_ground, backdrop); lune run tools/bake/neighbourhood_shop.luau; lune run tools/review/export.luau; lune run tools/review/neighbourhood_shop.luau; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/shop_scene.json --views docs/renders/neighbourhood_shop/views.json --out build/review/shop --threads 2. The shell is drawn from the bake; the owner's interior and roof from the very FBX files that were uploaded (tools/review/art_render.py), placed where the engine pivots them. Interior views are at a person's eye (floor + 5.2).
